1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of __greater than 50 nm and less than one micron__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __that participates in forming the nanoparticle__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a polyalkylenimine selected from the group of polyethylenimine or its derivatives__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, __not less than 50% of which is___anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, __zirconium phosphonate__, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein said cations are __present in a relative amount to the polyanion to form stable complexes__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of __from 100 to 800 nm__ in diameter.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from the group comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe, or Al, resulting in increased stability__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __zirconium or chromium ions as the crosslinking agent for the polyelectrolyte complex__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1 __with a defined particle size and ionic ratios influencing gelation kinetics__; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylic acid, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, __sodium acrylate, or sodium methacrylate__.
